description: Connect the person's own provider account so computers start on it and the provider bills them directly (Cerver adds no markup). Ask the person for the key once; never echo it. Fields: e2b → e2b_api_key; vercel → vercel_token, vercel_team_id, vercel_project_id; daytona → daytona_api_key; modal → modal token fields; boat → its key. A wrong key is rejected here.
